spans.s:
(उ) मञ्चु r. 1st cl. (मञ्चति)
To go.

m. (-ञ्चः)
1 A bed, a bedstead.
2 A platform, a scaffold.
3 An elevated shed raised on bambus in a cornfield, &c., where a watchman is stationed to protect the corn from cattle, birds, wild beasts, &c.
4 A sort of throne or chair of state, or the platform on which it is raised, the dais.
E.
मचि to be high or tall, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
1 A bed, a bedstead.
2 A platform, a scaffold.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-यः)
A bug.
E.
मञ्चक a bed, and आश्रय abode.

m. (-पः)
A sort of temporary open shed, a platform erected for particular ceremonies, as marriages, &c.
E.
मञ्च a scaffold, and मण्डप a temporary hall.

r. 10th cl. (मञ्जयति)
1 To sound.
2 To clean, to purify.

f. (-ञ्जा)
1 A compound pedicle: see the last.
2 A she-goat.
E.
मजि to sound, aff. अच्.

nf. (-रं-री)
1 A pearl.
2 A compound pedicle.
3 A sort of plant, commonly Tilaka.
E.
मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go or be, aff. अप्, deriv. irr: see the next.

f. (-रिः-री)
1 A compound pedicle, a fruit or flower stalk.
2 A large pearl.
3 A plant, commonly Tilaka.
mf. (-रिः-री)
A shoot, a sprout.
E.
मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go or be, aff. इ, deriv. irr., ङीप् optionally added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Mounted on a stalk, (a bud, &c.)
E.
मञ्जर, and इतच् aff.

f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी)
A compound pedicle; also मञ्जरी.

f. (-का)
A harlot, a whore.

f. (-ला)
The plantain, (Musa sapientum.)
E.
मञ्जि a foot-stalk, and फल fruit.

n. (-म)
Beauty, elegance.
E.
मञ्जु handsome, इमनिच् aff.

f. (-ष्ठा)
Bengal madder, a plant used in medicine, and in dying, (Rubia manjith, Rox.)
E.
मञ्जु beautiful, स्था to stay or be, क aff., deriv. irr.; or मञ्जि a compound pedicle, and स्थ aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं)
Of a red colour.
n. (-ष्ठं)
Red, the colour.
E.
मञ्जिष्ठा madder, used as a red dye, and अण् aff.

m. (-गः)
1 The dye of madder.
2 Permanent attachment.
E.
मञ्जिष्ठा, and राग colour.

n. (-रं)
An ornament for the feet or toes.
m. (-रः)
A post, round which passes the string that works the stick of a churn.
E.
मञ्ज to sound, aff. ईरन्; also with कन् added, मञ्जीरक.

m. (-लः)
A village, inhabited chiefly by washermen.
E.
मञ्ज to sound, ईरन् aff., and र changed to ल.

mfn. (-ञ्जुः-ञ्जुः-ञ्जु)
Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable.
E.
मजि to sound, aff. उ.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Beautiful-haired.
m. (-शी)
A name of KṚṢṆA, or VIṢṆU in that form.
E.
मञ्जु beautiful, केश hair, इनि aff.

f. (-ना)
A goose.
E.
मञ्जु beautiful, elegant, and गमन gait.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Having a sweet voice or cry.
m. (-षः)
One of the Bauddha teachers.
f. (-षा)
One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga.
E.
मञ्जु agreeable, and घोष sound, voice.

f. (-शी)
1 A name of

DURGĀ.
2
The wife of

INDRA.
3

A handsome woman.
E.
मञ्जु beautiful, and नाश destruction; putting every other beauty to shame by their superiority.

m. (-णः)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
मञ्जु pleasing, and प्राण life.

m. (-द्रः)
A Bauddha; also called Mañjughoṣa.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Speaking sweetly or pleasantly.
f. (-णी)
1 A woman speaking kindly.
2 A species of Atijagatī metre.
E.
मञ्जु, and भाषिन् who speaks.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Beautiful, agreeable, pleasing.
m. (-लः)
A gallinule
n. (-लं)
1 A natural water-course or channel.
2 An arbor, a bower.
3 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
E.
मञ्जु handsome, ला to be, aff. क.

mfn. (-क्त्रः-क्त्रा-क्त्रं)
Lovely, handsome.
E.
मञ्जु beautiful, वक्त्र the face.

m. (-श्रीः)
A Bauddha saint: see मञ्जुघोष.

f. (-षा)
1 A basket, a large basket.
2 A stone.
3 Bengal madder.
4 The case in which the great bow that RĀMA broke, was kept.
E.
मस्ज to make pure or clean by ablution, Uṇādi aff. ऊषन्, and the nasal augment; also with a short vowel मञ्जुषा.
